description: Implement an LRU cache with O(1) get and put operations. The cache should have a configurable max capacity and evict the least recently used item when full. Both get and put should count as 'use'.
test_code:
import pytest
from solution import LRUCache

def test_basic_put_get():
    c = LRUCache(2)
    c.put('a', 1)
    c.put('b', 2)
    assert c.get('a') == 1
    assert c.get('b') == 2

def test_miss():
    c = LRUCache(2)
    assert c.get('x') is None

def test_eviction():
    c = LRUCache(2)
    c.put('a', 1)
    c.put('b', 2)
    c.put('c', 3)  # evicts 'a'
    assert c.get('a') is None
    assert c.get('b') == 2
    assert c.get('c') == 3

def test_access_refreshes():
    c = LRUCache(2)
    c.put('a', 1)
    c.put('b', 2)
    c.get('a')  # refreshes 'a'
    c.put('c', 3)  # evicts 'b' (not 'a')
    assert c.get('a') == 1
    assert c.get('b') is None
    assert c.get('c') == 3

def test_update_existing():
    c = LRUCache(2)
    c.put('a', 1)
    c.put('b', 2)
    c.put('a', 10)  # update, refreshes
    c.put('c', 3)   # evicts 'b'
    assert c.get('a') == 10
    assert c.get('b') is None

def test_size():
    c = LRUCache(3)
    assert c.size() == 0
    c.put('a', 1)
    assert c.size() == 1
    c.put('b', 2)
    c.put('c', 3)
    c.put('d', 4)
    assert c.size() == 3

def test_capacity_one():
    c = LRUCache(1)
    c.put('a', 1)
    c.put('b', 2)
    assert c.get('a') is None
    assert c.get('b') == 2
